text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Summer training camp is over already, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Thanks to your support, I'd say I'm doing fairly well.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...In the Mainichi Okan and Tenno Sho (Autumn),
I'm sure we can surpass the past."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I have at least that much confidence.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Even though summer training camp is over,
please don't let your guard down, okay?

—And so, the final summer training camp
with Silence Suzuka came to an end.
